statement: All positive solutions of 4/n=1/x+1/y+1/z with x<y<z in arithmetic progression are obtained uniquely from coprime integers a>d>0 and t>=1. Put D=3a^2-d^2 and q=D when a,d have opposite parity, q=D/2 when both are odd. Then (x,y,z)=tq(a-d,a,a+d), and n=4ta(a^2-d^2) in the opposite-parity case, n=2ta(a^2-d^2) in the odd-odd case. In particular no primitive denominator triple exists.
scope_note: The universal result rests on the symbolic derivation in README.md. The bounded independent verifier is regression evidence, not a finite-to-infinite inference.
